title: kithctl: CLI scaffold with clap
description:
Set up kithctl binary: add clap to workspace, update kithctl Cargo.toml with all deps (clap, kith-store, tokio, rustls, serde_json, http-body-util, hyper-util), create src/config.rs with Config struct, rewrite src/main.rs with #[tokio::main] and clap subcommand dispatch.

WHAT: Establish the CLI scaffold that all other kithctl commands build on.

ALGORITHM:
1. In workspace Cargo.toml: add clap = { version = "4.5", features = ["derive"] } to [workspace.dependencies]
2. In crates/kithctl/Cargo.toml: add clap.workspace=true, kith-store.workspace=true, tokio.workspace=true, serde_json.workspace=true, http-body-util.workspace=true, hyper.workspace=true, hyper-util.workspace=true; also check if rustls and tokio-rustls are in workspace deps and add if available
3. Create crates/kithctl/src/config.rs:
   - struct Config { data_dir: PathBuf, ts_socket: String, port: u16 }
   - fn from_env() reads KITHD_DATA_DIR (default: $HOME/.local/share/kithd), KITHD_TAILSCALED_SOCKET (default: /var/run/tailscale/tailscaled.sock), KITHD_PORT parsed as u16 (default: 443)
   - fn db_path(&self) -> PathBuf { self.data_dir.join("kith.db") }
   - fn cert_path(&self) -> PathBuf { self.data_dir.join("kith.crt") }
4. Rewrite src/main.rs:
   - #[derive(Parser)] struct Cli with #[command(version)] and global flags: --data-dir: Option<PathBuf>, --socket: Option<String>, --port: Option<u16>
   - #[derive(Subcommand)] enum Commands { Status, Contacts { #[command(subcommand)] cmd: ContactsCmd }, Backup { dest: Option<PathBuf> }, Watch }
   - #[derive(Subcommand)] enum ContactsCmd { List }
   - #[tokio::main] async fn main(): parse Cli, build Config from_env() then apply CLI overrides, match on Commands and call stub fn for each
   - Each stub: returns Ok(()) printing "not yet implemented" so compile-check passes
5. Run cargo build -p kithctl; verify it compiles with exit 0

DEFENSIVE RULES:
- Never unwrap() env vars; use getenv + map + unwrap_or_else
- Port parse: str.parse::<u16>() must be matched; invalid KITHD_PORT logs warning and uses default 443
- data_dir: if HOME not set, fall back to /tmp/kithd with a warning; never panic
- No secrets or paths logged

TESTS: cargo build -p kithctl exits 0; binary accepts --help, --version, and all subcommand --help without panic
